title: CALRK-Bench: Evaluating Context-Aware Legal Reasoning in Korean Law

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of model predictions in a Judgment Shift Attribution (Type-JSA) task to detect systematic heuristic preferences or over-attributions to specific causes of legal change (e.g., factual premises vs. normative text), which reflects an underlying bias towards common law system patterns prevalent in English-centric training data.
